items.name: first_block_is_identity
items.source:
fn first_block_is_identity(blocks: &[Value]) -> bool {
    blocks
        .first()
        .and_then(|block| block.get("text"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .is_some_and(|text| text.starts_with(CLAUDE_CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT))
}

Value is an immutable checked recursive algebraic value, not an untyped JavaScript object; mutable borrows remain frontend obligations. Numbers preserve i64/u64 BigInt and finite binary64 independently; invalid typed values abort rather than being coerced to JSON null. Default decimal decoding follows the pinned source u64 accumulator and rounded binary64 scaling, including truncated overflowing fractional digits. Object keys follow Rust UTF-8 byte order, duplicate input keys retain their last value, and JSON strings contain Unicode scalar values. Rust differential execution remains gated on the full JavaScript checks; source-derived numeric and syntax fixtures do not establish whole-program parity.
